straints or more serious consequences in that domain.

evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Deterministic rule-based environment scoring of task completion, state changes, safety conditions, and resource use.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims regarding the relative merits of persistent memory systems, cross-session retention gaps, and differing trade-offs between static fact retrieval and dynamic state tracking are well supported by the experimental results and paired ablations.
primary.evaluation_assessment: The empirical evaluation is thorough, executing 26,880 main experiment runs and 20,160 paired ablation runs across six system configurations, complete with 95% bootstrap confidence intervals, token efficiency metrics, and random-chance baselines.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Evaluated systems were frozen and tested directly without optimization against the evaluation metric.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Deterministic environment scoring function assessing state transitions, task completion, safety violations, and resource expenditure.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Not applicable; the benchmark evaluates off-the-shelf and baseline agent configurations (Pi Agent, RAG, Mem0, CoM, LightMem, SpaceMind) without tuning or training them against the benchmark's score.

primary.limitations: The authors transparently report limitations, including focus on discrete turn histories rather than continuous real-time execution, specific simulation constraints, and potential bias favoring static fact retention over dynamic procedural execution.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology systematically operationalizes operational challenges into 140 templates across 9 scenario tasks with deterministic environment state transitions, isolated session management, and deterministic rule-based scoring based on task completion, state updates, safety constraints, and resource consumption.
primary.quality_rationale: The paper makes an extensive, rigorously validated contribution to evaluating embodied agent memory in domain-specific constraints with deterministic programmatic grading, controlled ablations, and clear reporting of statistical uncertainty.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces AstroMemBench, a comprehensive benchmark and Scenario-Challenge-Capability design framework for evaluating long-term memory systems in embodied spacecraft agents across 16 subchallenges and 2,240 test instances.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline gains are measured by environment-native success predicates and external benchmark execution that do not depend on the teacher's token likelihoods, and these corroborate the reported improvements [E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0041, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0076, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0145].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Objective environment outcomes: verifiable purchase sequences in Shop, hidden test execution in Coding, private grader metrics in AutoResearch, rubric-gated system state in General, and absolute visual grading in Visual, plus external Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2 execution [E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0030, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0041, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0076, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0145].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Token-level teacher-student log-probability gaps from a frozen Qwen3.8-27B teacher over student-sampled prefixes, used as the reverse-KL on-policy distillation objective [E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0012, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0024].

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Reported claims of superior performance and generalization are well supported by quantitative results showing a 64.6% average success rate on CAMG-II test tasks and consistent improvements over baseline models on external coding benchmarks [E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0024, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0041].
primary.evaluation_assessment: Empirical evaluation tests multiple baselines (MemOPD, HELM, CompactOPD, CAMP-I) across five distinct domains with multi-seed variance reporting, memory intervention ablations (intact vs. shuffled vs. removed memory), and external transfer benchmarks (Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2) [E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0024, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0031, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0038, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0041, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0146].

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline performance gains are corroborated by verifiable programmatic tests, execution unit test suites, and established external benchmarks (Terminal-Bench 2.1 and SWE-Bench Pro V2) that do not depend on teacher token likelihoods [E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0041, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0076].
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Objective environment outcomes and external benchmark execution suites (Shop purchase validity, test-suite execution in Coding/SWE-Bench, metric scores in AutoResearch, and Terminal-Bench evaluation) [E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0030, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0041, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0076, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0145].
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Token-level log-probability gaps from a frozen Qwen3.8-27B teacher evaluated over student rollout prefixes via reverse-KL on-policy distillation [E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0012, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0023].

primary.limitations: The authors explicitly state limitations regarding evaluation scope, noting that experiments were restricted to models up to 9B parameters with a single frozen 27B teacher, leaving larger scales and multi-teacher distillation unexamined [E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0043].
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is thoroughly detailed, describing the shared Bash file-memory interface, context replacement protocol, fully asynchronous OPD setup using reverse KL from a frozen teacher, and theoretical cost modeling under rare-action regimes [E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0012, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0021, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0026, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0118, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0136].
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript presents a rigorous investigation into leveraging filesystem priors for language agent memory distillation, supported by extensive baseline comparisons, multi-seed training runs, mechanistic ablations, and external benchmark validation.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces CAMG-II, a five-environment suite for evaluating agent long-horizon memory via ordinary filesystem operations, and CAMP-II, an asynchronous on-policy distillation method training agents to maintain and read memory via Bash without task rewards [E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0007, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0008, E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0072].

scholarly_quality.rationale: The manuscript presents a rigorous investigation into leveraging filesystem priors for language agent memory distillation, supported by extensive baseline comparisons, multi-seed training runs, mechanistic ablations, and external benchmark validation.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors explicitly state limitations regarding evaluation scope, noting that experiments were restricted to models up to 9B parameters with a single frozen 27B teacher, leaving larger scales and multi-teacher distillation unexamined [E39fdd122f4b637a4-B0043].
